primary_task: Iterate on a GitHub PR: fetch checks/feedback with gh + uv scripts, fix failures, commit, push, and loop until actionable CI passes.

requirements.name: github
requirements.check: gh auth status; gh api user --jq .login
requirements.observed: auth status says GH_TOKEN invalid, but gh api user via session proxy returns login 'ginaecho'; per-repo API access requires add_repo

requirements.name: Monitor
requirements.evidence: Claude Code optional: run monitor through MonitorTool

notes: gh is authenticated through the session's GitHub proxy; accessing the target repo's API/push requires attaching it via add_repo (push access), which is the documented in-session mechanism. 'gh auth status' alone reports token invalid.
